title: Steve Frank O'Bara Jr. | Obituaries | rutlandherald.com
text:
Steve Frank O’Bara Jr. RUTLAND — Steve Frank O’Bara Jr., 77 of Rutland died Tuesday morning September 15, 2026, at his residence in Rutland with his loving wife by his side. He was born on March 28, 1949, in Proctor. Steve graduated from the West Rutland High School in 1969 then enlisted in the U.S. Army where he served for 3 years in the Vietnam War. During his time in the service, he was awarded the Bronze Star prior to his honorable discharge. He married Linda Champine on December 24, 1986. During their time together they raised three loving children. Steve was employed by the General Electric Company for 32 years until his retirement in 2006. He enjoyed building model cars, hunting, fishing and was an old car enthusiast. Steve was a member of the American Legion Post #31 in Rutland and the Veterans of Foreign Wars post # 648. Survivors include his wife Linda of 39 years who resides in Rutland, a son Steve F. O’Bara ||| (partner) Nicole Zobel, their three sons, Colton, Wyatt and Nash of Middletown Springs. A daughter, Heather O’Bara and her children Brielle and Jace Duprey of Chittenden, one Great Granddaughter Mackenzie “Sweet Pea” Camara and her father Zachariah and a step Grandson Nicholas Duprey. A second daughter Kayla O’Bara (significant other Brian Buffum) and their blended family, Emily, Bradley, Emily B., Sylas B., and Weston B. of Cavendish. He was predeceased by his father Steve O’Bara on Feb 23, 1986. His brother-in-law Richard Gresham and a sister-in-law Joyce Champine. A celebration of life will be held at a later date. In lieu of flowers the family asks that any donations be made to the American Heart Association of VT. Arrangements are with the Aldous Funeral Home
Steve Frank O'Bara Jr.
